theme_strategy.rationale: For SaaS analytics dashboards in 2026, dark mode is critical. It prevents eye strain during extended sessions and allows metrics to pop. We follow ARCHETYPE 5 (LUXURY) mixed with ARCHETYPE 4 (SWISS). Deep, cinematic, but functionally rigorous.

headings.usage: Use for all H1-H4 headings, key metric numbers (KPIs), and brand logo.

body.usage: Use for all body text, tables, sub-labels, and tooltips.

typography.guidelines: Inter is BANNED for headings. Ensure tight line heights (leading-none) for metric values.

colors.guidelines: Avoid pure black (#000000). Use Deep Obsidian (#0A0A0A). Reserve bright colors ONLY for status/alerts. Charts should use monochrome/neutral shades to maintain a premium feel. DO NOT use teal green (#1B93A4) for dashboards.

dashboard_overview.classes: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4 md:gap-6
dashboard_overview.rules: Every pixel must be utilized. Use 'h-full' on children to ensure they stretch to match their neighbors. No jagged bottoms.

layouts_and_grids.spacing_system: Generous Spacing Philosophy. Use p-6 or p-8 inside cards. Containers with borders MUST have internal padding to prevent text collision.

headers.classes: sticky top-0 z-50 bg-[#0A0A0A]/80 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-[#27272A]

buttons.secondary: bg-transparent border border-[#27272A] text-white hover:bg-[#1A1A1A] font-medium rounded-lg

surfaces_and_components.tables: Row separation via 1px solid bottom border (#27272A) and distinct hover states (hover:bg-[#121212]). Text contrast must be crisp.

rules: Distinguish chart series by stroke style or distinct neutral shades, not just saturation.
Remove all default grid lines or make them extremely subtle (stroke='#27272A', strokeDasharray='3 3').
Tooltips must use the Glassmorphism style with high-contrast text.
Ensure charts remain legible without relying on fuzzy shadows.
Hover states for all interactive elements are MANDATORY.
Use specific transitions (e.g., transition-colors, transition-transform), NEVER transition-all.
Entrance animations: Staggered fade-up for list items/table rows.
Focus states MUST have higher contrast than default.

icons.sizing: Use w-5 h-5 for standard icons, w-4 h-4 for inline metrics.

backgrounds.description: Abstract minimal dark background for agency banner or hero

accessibility.contrast: Maintain 4.5:1 minimum contrast for text. Use APCA guidelines for critical data.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements (buttons, inputs, menu items, table actions) MUST include data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='add-creator-btn').

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. Break the mold. Make this dashboard feel like a high-end, cinematic tool for professional creators.
Never use pure black or simplistic gradients. Create depth with 1px borders and distinct #121212 / #1A1A1A layer separation.
Do NOT apply universal transitions (transition: all).
Do NOT center align the app container text.
NEVER use placeholder URLs (via.placeholder.com). Use the provided image_urls.
Prioritize Shadcn UI for complex components, but heavily customize the borders and backgrounds to match the 'Luxury Swiss' aesthetic.
Install and use Outfit and Manrope via Google Fonts in index.css.
Use 'sonner' for toast notifications, customized to dark mode.

instructions_to_main_agent.setup: Update index.css to import Outfit and Manrope. Set root variables to match the dark theme defined above. The dashboard must default to dark mode.
instructions_to_main_agent.layout: Create a responsive sidebar navigation with glassmorphic top header on mobile. Ensure main content area has ample padding (p-6 or p-8).
instructions_to_main_agent.social_media_cards: In the Social Media Integration section, use the platform's brand color subtly (e.g., hover border color or a tiny indicator dot), but keep the card background neutral (#121212).
instructions_to_main_agent.creator_management: Use the provided avatar URLs for mock data in the table. Implement staggered entry animations for table rows.
